note: Set A is largely accurate and well-bound, capturing the Region 1½ speed range, Region 2/2½/3 control laws, the 0.482 peak power coefficient with its tip-speed ratio 7.55, pitch 0.0° and 8 m/s conditions, the 0.0255764 N·m/rpm² constant with the 97:1 gearbox condition, and the rated speed/power/torque values. Set A's clear errors are the rated mechanical power (5.298610 MW instead of the source's 5.296610 MW) and binding the up-to-fourth-order state-space statement to the baseline filter when the text attributes it to the alternative filters considered. Set B repeats many claims verbatim and introduces several substantive errors: it states Region 2 torque is proportional to the square of rotor speed (the text says filtered generator speed), drops the minus sign and invents a quote for the filter roll-off (6 dB/octave), garbles or truncates quotes (e.g. "[missing]", "mum rotor speed", "gion, is a linear transition"), misbinds the Region 1½ transition to the whole controller and the power coefficient to the wind turbine, and omits needed conditions such as Region 3 and the tip-speed ratio. Both sets share the 5.298610 MW misread, but B adds far more misbound, duplicated and unsupported claims.
